messages:
sara_csm: Heads up — PilgrimForms renewal ~39 days out. MAU down ~49% last 30d (active seats 240 -> 122). Our champion moved teams last week and inbox dark.

infra-bot: Alert: acct_pilgrimforms usage -49% (30d) vs baseline. Alert ID: UDA-20260525-13.

tom_ae: Is there any telemetry showing errors or dropped callbacks? Procurement said they demoed "FormPilot" last month.

leo_se: Onboarding checklist stalled at 62% (webhook validation + sample payloads). I see a short window of 502/504 and a few 429s during nightly syncs. Snippet: ```
2026-05-25T04:12:03Z WARN 502 /v1/webhook acct=pilgrimforms req=sync-11
2026-05-25T04:12:05Z ERROR 504 /v1/webhook acct=pilgrimforms req=sync-12
2026-05-25T04:12:59Z ERROR 429 /v1/generate acct=pilgrimforms pid=gw-15
```

sara_csm: thanks. Looks like two tracks: (1) infra triage to determine if failures caused lost records, (2) outreach to new PM + procurement to re-engage and offer SE support.

maria_head: agree. Prioritize triage. If the issue is on our edge we offer remediation + credit; if it's integration, offer SE hours and an adoption workshop. Also prepare a small commercial incentive contingent on a 6mo renewal.

leo_se: Action: I'll correlate gateway spikes with webhook retries and confirm whether we can run a recovery/backfill. ETA 5h.

tom_ae: I'll draft outreach to the new PM (listed in Okta as "P. Cho"): "Hi P — we noticed activity dropped and your champion moved teams. Can we book 30m to triage integration and blockers? We can assign SE hours to help finish validation." Approve?

sara_csm: approve. Add: "We're investigating transient gateway errors and will share a remediation plan in the call."

infra-bot: Reminder: create renewal_watch ticket in Salesforce (acct_pilgrimforms, renewal_39d) — ticket #RW-20260525-21.

sara_csm: created SF ticket RW-20260525-21 and linked to onboarding-rescue playbook. Will update when log audit and backfill plan complete. :white_check_mark:
